newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Equatorial Guinea's president leaves Morocco.
newsitem.headline: Equatorial Guinea's president leaves Morocco.

text.p: Equatorial Guinea's President Teodoro Obiang Nguema Mbasogo left Morocco on Sunday after a private visit, the official Moroccan news agency MAP said.
The president met King Hassan on Saturday at his palace of Skhirat near Rabat, but no details were available on their talks.

A Western diplomat said Morocco and Equatorial Guinea cooperated closely in security matters. Dozens of Moroccan security officers were sent to Equatorial Guinea to train Obiang Naguema Mbasogo's bodyguards in the past, he added.
